environment.description: EKS pod in namespace 'pki-services-hardened' with Bottlerocket AMI nodes. Pod runs with a custom seccomp profile (pki-cert-service-seccomp-v2.json) loaded via annotations that restricts the 'openat' syscall using a conditional BPF filter: the filter permits openat only when the resolved fd path prefix matches entries in an allowlist embedded in the profile (/opt/certs/public/*, /opt/hsm/slots/*/metadata.json, /opt/cloudhsm/lib/*, /usr/lib/*, /proc/self/fd/*). Additionally, the pod's ServiceAccount has an IAM Role with a session policy boundary that restricts sts:AssumeRole and prevents token exfiltration. The container uses a read-only root filesystem with explicit tmpfs at /tmp only. Istio sidecar enforces mTLS with AuthorizationPolicy restricting source principals to 'cluster.local/ns/api-gateway/sa/gateway-sa'.

config.seccomp_profile_summary: BPF filter on openat/openat2 syscalls with pathname argument inspection via SECCOMP_RET_TRACE + ptrace supervisor daemon that validates resolved paths against allowlist before permitting the syscall to proceed
